items.title: Jailer 2 becomes the new Tamil Industry Hit
items.sum: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has broken box office records to become the new highest-grossing Tamil film of all time. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the sequel crossed the Rs.800 crore worldwide gross mark in just 19 days. Trade estimates put the total worldwide collection at approximately Rs.812 crore, surpassing Rajinikanth's previous record with 2.0. Producer G Dhananjheyan celebrated the milestone on social media, stating, "Every box office record has been broken and we should all celebrate the Team #Jailer2 for giving us the New Industry Hit."

items.sum: Commercial Tamil and Telugu cinema frequently reduces female characters, especially pregnant women, to mere plot devices and symbols rather than individuals with agency. items.sum: Filmmaker Sundar C discusses his latest directorial venture Mookuthi Amman 2 starring Nayanthara, which releases in theatres this week. Sundar explains that the standalone fantasy sequel is not a traditional devotional film, stating that the deity must save herself instead of protecting others. The movie also features veteran actor Urvashi but has no narrative connection to the 2020 original film. Sundar adds that the project came together coincidentally when producer Ishari K Ganesh approached him while he was developing a story spanning two different time periods.
